questions.text: This is the second game in the series. After the success of the first title, this game focuses on the story of an important side character.
This game was one of the most anticipated indie games.
Development of this game began as an expansion for the original game before evolving into a standalone title.
This game was nominated for Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2025.
It is the sequel to a critically acclaimed 2017 Metroidvania developed by Team Cherry.
